subject: Expansion: add three apps & staged provisioning - commit addendum
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@novafabric.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novafabric.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion: add three apps & staged provisioning - commit addendum

Hi Samir —

Great to see NovaFabric’s traction on the pilot. Per our conversation last week, you mentioned spinning up three additional internal apps (SearchAssist, BillingOps, and ClaimsPipe) over the next two quarters and wanting the keys provisioned per team.

Quick proposal to move this forward:
- Addendum to current contract for a 12-month staged commit (starts 2026-11-01) with a 25% uplift on committed tokens in Q1 and an additional 15% in Q2.
- Staged API key issuance: keys for SearchAssist next week, BillingOps on 11/15, ClaimsPipe on 12/01.
- Initial burst capacity reserved for onboarding week (one-off) and automated throttling thereafter.

I attached a draft SOW addendum and a simple rollout spreadsheet showing key owners and dates. Can you confirm procurement loop-in and whether the billing cadence needs to stay monthly or move to quarterly?

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirms PO path and required PO number (cc procurement).
2) We finalize addendum and sign, then we provision keys on the dates above.
3) Ben (cc’d) will own onboarding runbooks for each app and a quick enablement session.

If that aligns, I’ll have Laura draft the formal addendum and route to your procurement contact.

Thanks —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: nova_sow_addendum_v2.pdf, staged_key_rollout.xlsx

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novafabric.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir@novafabric.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novafabric.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: add three apps & staged provisioning - commit addendum

Thanks Rafael — this looks reasonable. A few clarifications from our side before procurement signs off: 
- Can you confirm the uplift math (we need line items by token bucket per month)?
- Do you offer any onboarding credit or discount tied to the staging plan? We have a ramp where SearchAssist will use ~1.2M tokens/month initially.
- For BillingOps, we need the keys segregated by environment (staging vs prod) so our SRE can manage secrets properly.

Procurement: looping you in — can you advise on required contract language for a 12-month addendum and whether a PO or a signed addendum is preferable?

Samir
Priya

On Oct 10, 2026, at 9:12 AM, Rafael Mendes wrote:
> Great to see NovaFabric’s traction on the pilot. Per our conversation last week...

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novafabric.com>, Samir Shah <samir@novafabric.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: add three apps & staged provisioning - commit addendum

Thanks Priya — answers inline below and updated attachments attached.

- Uplift math: see tab "Commit Schedule" in staged_key_rollout.xlsx — I summarized monthly committed tokens and the uplift rows in the SOW addendum. High level: Q1 uplift adds 25% to your current baseline (apportioned by app), Q2 adds +15% more. I included a simple example for SearchAssist at 1.2M tokens/month.
- Onboarding credit: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first three months of additional committed usage (applied as account credits). I put the language in the addendum (nova_sow_addendum_v2.pdf).
- Segregated keys: we will issue environment-tagged API keys (staging/prod) and map them in the spreadsheet. Keys will follow your SRE naming conventions if you share them.

Procurement note: Laura can route the addendum as either a PO-based addendum or a signed amendment depending on what your procurement prefers. Typical path: procurement issues PO referencing the addendum; we activate once PO is received. If you want a DocuSign signature instead, we can send that.

Proposed timeline:
- 10/13: procurement confirms PO path & key naming conventions
- 10/15: Laura routes addendum to procurement for PO or DocuSign
- 11/01: provision SearchAssist keys and start Q1 commit

Laura and Ben will take the operational follow-up. Let me know if you want any changes to the credit or the ramp.

Best,
Rafael

Attachments: nova_sow_addendum_v2.pdf, staged_key_rollout.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@novafabric.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@novafabric.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@novafabric.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: add three apps & staged provisioning - commit addendum

Hi all — looping in next steps from the Redwood ops side.

- Procurement: if you can confirm PO path (PO referenced to "Redwood Inference - SOW Addendum"), we can accept either a PO or a signed DocuSign. If PO, please include the project code in the body so finance maps correctly.
- Ben will run three 30-minute enablement sessions (one per app) and deliver runbooks; proposed slots are 10/25, 10/28, 11/02. Please confirm preferred times.
- We will provision environment-tagged keys into your tenant namespace; security team can audit naming. Keys will be flagged in our console as: novafabric-<app>-<env>-key-01.

I cc’d Redwood Billing for visibility on the credit. Rafael — I updated the addendum to include the 10% onboarding credit and the staged activation dates. I will route for DocuSign this afternoon unless procurement requests PO.

Action items for NovaFabric:
1) Procurement: confirm PO vs DocuSign and provide PO template or contact.
2) SRE/DevSec: confirm key naming convention and whether we should provision separate service accounts per app.
3) Request preferred slots for enablement sessions.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0123
